title: Typed entry point AzGuard\AzGuard, generated facade and storage descriptor
summary: `AzGuard\AzGuard` replaces `AzGuardManager` with the exact signatures of knowledge/contracts#entry (typed subject union, `storage()`/`storages()` returning the new `Storage\StorageDescriptor`), the facade `@method` block is generated from it and tested for equality, the manifest records facade methods and `AzGuardFake` mirrors the same public methods.
why: A facade with zero recorded methods evades the manifest (P2#pitfalls); `mixed $subject` hides the accepted types; Audit and applications need storage identity without reaching internal `Storage\Storage` (D10, contracts#storage). Hard risk: the container alias `azguard` and facade accessor must keep resolving the same singleton so Octane/queue scoping is unchanged.

include: Rename `AzGuardManager` → `AzGuard` (Api, since 1.0) with every method of knowledge/contracts#entry; constructor `@internal`; `check()/authorize()` subject `Model|Authenticatable|SubjectRef`

New `Storage\StorageDescriptor` (Api) exactly as knowledge/contracts#storage incl. `canonicalKey()`; built from `Storage\StorageRegistry`/typed config; `storage(string $id = 'default')`, `storages(): list<StorageDescriptor>`; unknown id → `InvalidConfigurationException`

`Facades\AzGuard` docblock `@method static` block generated from `AzGuard\AzGuard` public methods (a `--write` mode of bin/api-manifest.php or a dedicated `bin/facade-methods.php` invoked by `composer api:manifest`), `@see AzGuard\AzGuard`; manifest `facade` section; ApiManifestTest asserts facade block == entry methods
`Testing\AzGuardFake` exposes the same public methods (signatures equal; test compares reflection)
Container binding/alias `azguard` and `AzGuardServiceProvider` updated; all callers (core, filament, tests, bench, docs) updated
exclude: Any new consumer method beyond knowledge/contracts#entry

reads.why: Rules every P2 item follows (reference wins, no shims, D17 placement, attributes, snapshots, migration lines)
Exact validation commands and driver environment
Owners/roots, Internal placement rule, stable FQCNs, composition roots — where new files go
Facade as Laravel adapter, generated and tested; typed union

rules: The facade block is never hand-edited: `composer api:check` fails when it differs from the generated text.
`StorageDescriptor::canonicalKey()` reuses the existing host-key canonicalization (no second algorithm).

validation.cmd: php -d memory_limit=1G vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/Parity tests/Feature/InactiveCost tests/Regression/Baseline070 --fail-on-skipped
composer analyse && composer lint:check && composer refactor:check && composer api:check

deliverables: Generated, tested facade method block and manifest facade section
